article.story: LEXINGTON, Va. -- — Rickey Bradley scored 21 points as VMI beat Gardner-Webb 71-68 on Saturday. Bradley also added four steals for the Keydets (4-3). Trap Johnson scored 15 points and added five rebounds. Paulius Narvilas had 10 points and finished 4 of 4 from the floor. Seth Brown led the way for the Runnin’ Bulldogs (1-5) with 20 points and three steals. Mikhail Pocknett added 17 points, eight rebounds and two steals for Gardner-Webb. Aaron Talbert also had eight points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
